system.description: Use this Skill in populated areas to learn or spread rumors, avoid attracting too much attention, gain access to less-than-legal items, and the like. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you navigate a town without attracting attention, deal with a criminal network, identify an informal power structure, or gain the information you're seeking.

upgrades.description: You also hear an additional rumor, as determined by the GM. Or spread one!
You also quickly find a hiding place determined by the GM.
You also uncover information that might give you some leverage on an important person in town determined by the GM.
